I ported both scripts to Godot 4 and haven't run them, since Godot isn't installed here. In `turret.gd` and `bullet.gd`, `export` and `onready` became `@export` and `@onready`, and `instance()` became `instantiate()`. I also switched to the `timer.timeout.connect(...)` and `fired.emit(...)` signal syntax.
